Commentary.Commentary: ...RUN CHASE...

Craig Young is in for a quick chat and says that it was nice to get through any batting line-up and we managed to do that well today. Adds that the plan was to bowl short stuff with cross seam and we executed it well today. Also adds that he was fit but just wasn't being picked as the other players were doing good. Closes by saying that he will be young forever and it feels so good to bowl them out for cheap now they would want to win.

Right then, the USA have 196 runs on the board. They will now be dependent on their bowlers to pick some early wickets and give some fight. For Ireland, the batters just need a good stand at the start, and they will be hoping to win this one. Which side will come out on top? Let's find out soon. Chase coming up shortly...

To be honest, there is nothing much to write about the USA batters. Sushant Modani and Saiteja Mukkamalla scored a half-century and that was it. Most of the USA batters were dismissed on a single digit which included a couple of the batters on duck as well. A late surge from Usman Rafiq helped to team to get to a fighting total but it still is a below-par score.

That was a clinical performance from the Irish bowlers. They never let the USA batters settle in the game. It was Young and McBrine at the start who ran havoc over the opponent batters. They chipped in with 3 and 2 wickets respectively. The 3rd wicket partnership was a bit difficult to break but they made sure the job was done.

OUT! IN THE AIR AND GONE! That's it for the USA innings as they get bowled out on 196 well short of 50 overs. Short-pitched delivery body-bound, Ali Khan clears up his front leg and looks to pull it over mid on but mishits this off the bottom of his bat in the hands of Gareth Delany at mid on.

Commentary.Commentary: We are done with the pre-match formalities as the players are ready for the game to start. Sushant Modani and Steven Taylor are the two openers for the USA, while Mark Adair will bowl the first over.
The match officials are out in the middle followed by the players of both sides. It is time for the National Anthems of the respective nations.

Pitch Report-: The pitch looks solid to bat on as it is dry with a bit of grass and it will be solid to bat on throughout the day. Adds that the pitch will be more suitable to the batters than bowlers and as history suggests it is better for chasing than setting up a total.

Monank Patel says that the wicket looks good to bat on as it is a bit on the dry side and they would want to post a total in excess of 280 today. Adds that it is a brilliant chance to put them on the cricketing map again with a win against a full-member nation. Informs they have got three changes.

Andy Balbirnie says they would like to bowl first as the conditions seem to favor the pacers early on for the first 15 overs. Adds they just want to perform well and go home with a bit of smile on everybody's face.

USA (Playing XI) - Sushant Modani, Steven Taylor, Monank Patel (C) (WK), Saiteja Mukkamalla (replaces Aaron Jones), Gajanand Singh, Nisarg Patel, Abhishek Paradkar, Nosthush Kenjige, Usman Rafiq, Ali Khan (replaces Jessy Singh), Saurabh Netravalkar (replaces Shayan Jahangir).

Ireland (Playing XI) - Paul Stirling, Andy McBrine, Andy Balbirnie (C), Harry Tector, Lorcan Tucker (WK), Curtis Campher, George Dockrell, Gareth Delany, Mark Adair, Barry McCarthy, Craig Young (replaces Joshua Little).
TOSS-: Ireland have won the toss and elected to BOWL first.

On the flip side, the USA are yet to win a game in this competition. They will be down on confidence as their last game against the hosts was a shocking one. They lost by a huge margin of 304 runs. They failed to perform with the bat and ball. They will need to bounce back from this and come back stronger. Can they do it? Or will the Irish men seal a win here? We shall find out soon. Toss and team news to follow shortly...

Hello and a warm welcome folks! it is time for the playoffs game as Ireland will go against the USA. The former were a good side to challenge for the top 3 spots but the defeat in the first game against Oman and another defeat against the mighty Lankans sealed their fate. They will be pretty upset with the performance but they will need to leave this behind and start fresh in this game.
...MATCH DAY...

The Super Six stages of the ICC Cricket World Cup Qualifiers 2023 are going on but there is another round of matches to see which team finishes seventh. Having been knocked out of the race to qualify for the World Cup, Ireland will be facing a winless USA in the 7th place play-off semi-final at the Takashinga Sports Club in Harare. Whoever wins will face either Nepal or UAE in the final. The Irish were expected to be challenging for the top three spots but the opening game defeat to Oman was a shocker and then a heartbreaking loss to Scotland and a thrashing against Sri Lanka sealed their fate. Although they won their last game against UAE and their players are in decent form, Paul Stirling who scored a big hundred in the last match, Andy Balbirnie, Harry Tector, and Lorcan Tucker form a strong top and middle order. Joshua Little and Mark Adair will be leading the bowling attack and will be key players to watch out for while Curtis Campher has been decent in both departments. They will be confident about getting the victory. USA, on the other hand, lost all their matches but it is the experience that matters most for them. However, They looked promising in their first outing and even though they lost, they had given West Indies a tough fight. Since then, USA’s performance has been a downward graph but their key players have also been suffering from illness which didn't help them too. Their batting hasn't been that great but Gajanand Singh scored a brilliant century against the Windies and Shayan Jahangir also looked in good touch but they needed more from their skipper, Monank Patel. Ali Khan, Jessy Singh, Abhishek Paradkar, and Saurabh Netravalkar are the bowlers who’ve made a significant impact with the ball and will be crucial if they want to put up a fight. Let's see who comes out on top.
